On her turn, a player must place an X- or □-shaped piece of her color, depending on the constraint imposed by her opponent’s last piece. As soon as a player has lined up four pieces of their color or captured four squares of the same color, they win the game. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Game Overview 2 Goal of the Game (Instant Win) 3 Gameplay 4 Pro Tips Game Overview Quatrix combines line-building and area control strategy with a forcing mechanic. Every move restricts the opponent's freedom of action. Goal of the Game (Instant Win) You win the game immediately if: You form a continuous line of 4 of your color (horizontal, vertical, diagonal). OR You occupy (capture) 4 squares of the same color (e.g., 4x Blue) with your pieces. Gameplay Place a piece on an empty cell. The symbol on your piece dictates the opponent's mandatory next move: X Symbol: The opponent must place their next piece on a cell in a diagonal line from your piece. Square Symbol (□): The opponent must place their next piece on a cell in an orthogonal line (horizontal/vertical). Free Choice: If all cells in the required directions are occupied, the opponent may place their piece anywhere on an empty cell. Pro Tips Be careful to not let your opponent capture quickly 3 same colors ! Keep a balance between your X and □ pieces but force your opponent to spend one of the kind.
